title: KYLR: Prompt-Coded FPS / Slop Alert
author: vaibhavpandeyvpz
selftext:
Slop disclaimer first, I only made the Figma map layouts by hand. Codex made the game 100%. But it was not like one prompt <> full game. This is 4th iteration of the idea/implementation and took like over a month for this one.

![img](h887u6ynnmwh1 "KYLR - Blender scene render")

I liked the Secret Level’s Unreal Tournament episode, the way my fav. maps (DM Morpheus and Facing Worlds), weapon pickups etc. etc. were there and the arena setting. Even the character in KYLR is my best effort model of XAN 🤣 that I could do with prompt.

I made the source open if it may benefit anyone (especially the ray tracing work among all stuff) as this was all just an experiment on understanding how game internals work. Binary Windows releases and source code is here: [https://github.com/vaibhavpandeyvpz/kylr](https://github.com/vaibhavpandeyvpz/kylr)
